fields.name: archetype
fields.validation: else 400 'archetype must be cover, divider or content'

fields.name: box

box must be {left, top, width, height} as slide fractions

errors.when: blob/DB failure or furniture.json not valid JSON

sideEffects: If brand/<ownerId>/<brandId>/furniture.json exists and has layouts[archetype]: sets layouts[archetype].placeholders.heading = {...prevHeading, ...box} (keeps e.g. font/color/size keys as stored, incl. the furniture's own 'size' key) and rewrites the blob (brand-heading.ts:57-72)
externalCalls: Supabase, Netlify Blobs; no paid APIs
quirks: Kit preview entry keeps only font/color(#RRGGBB)/sizePt from the previous normalized entry; previous 'size' alias is read as sizePt (brandKit.ts:172).
Works even when the brand has no furniture (furnitureUpdated:false) - kit still updated.
Not atomic: furniture.json written before kit update.
beforeAnyState: Brand with empty kit and no furniture: 200 {headingPlaceholders:{[archetype]: box}, furnitureUpdated:false}.

tests.asserts: moves preview title box keeping styling and other archetypes; moves export heading in furniture.json under owner (keeps 'size'); updates preview when archetype has no furniture; 400 for bad archetype/box; 403 read-only; 404 unreachable
